newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: U.S. corn major net sales activity in the week ended Oct 10 reported by exporters for the following purchasing countries, in tonnes:
A-includes 85,300 in new sales and 30,000 in destination changes. B-includes new purchases of 56,100, destination changes of 52,000 and cancelations of 52,500.
Total net sales of 858,000 tonnes were eight percent higher than the previous week and 16 percent abovethe four-week average.
Exports of 555,700 tonnes were 24 percent below the previous week, and 10 percent under the four-week average.
Primary export destinations: Japan (175,100), Mexico (95,200), South Korea (109,700) and Taiwan (55,600).
